about_the_game:
Uncover even more sinister secrets and arcane lore in the thrilling DLC expansion to "Secrets of Salem: Shadow of the Witch"! Embark on a journey through four brand-new locations teeming with chilling mysteries, challenging mini-games, and additional hidden objects to discover. Immerse yourself in Salem’s hidden past by investigating the deaths of fallen witches, digging into dusty tomes that unveil the origins of your coven, and collecting potent supernatural artifacts. As you explore each eerie corner and unravel cryptic puzzles, you’ll earn unique achievements that showcase your deepening mastery of the Salem witches’ secret history.

Join the hunt, unlock new supernatural artifacts, and delve deeper than ever into the world of the Salem witches. Will you piece together the lost chronicles of your forebears and guide your coven toward salvation—or will the ghosts of the past consume you?

🔮 LEARN THE HISTORY OF THE SALEM WITCHES!

Unravel the dark history of Salem's witches and uncover the truth behind your coven's shadowy secrets. Every artifact you discover and every clue you uncover will deepen your understanding of the witches' trials, their powers, and the ancient lore of Salem!

🔮 SEARCH THE LOCKED ROOM!

Hidden behind a secret passage from the common room, this room is filled with secrets waiting to be uncovered. Search the dresser, closet, and walls for vital artifacts and clues. Each item holds a piece of the puzzle to unraveling the deeper mysteries of the witches!

🔮 EXPLORE THE SECRET LIBRARY!

The coven’s hidden archive, filled with well-preserved ancient tomes, awaits your discovery. Solve intricate mini-games to unlock the secrets contained in its books. Learn the fascinating history of the witches’ coven as you uncover long-lost knowledge!

🔮 DISCOVER THE AMULET OF LIGHT!

A location steeped in legend, this room holds the key to understanding the Amulet of Light. Solve its challenging mini-games and piece together the story of the amulet’s first awakening, a tale shrouded in magic and mystery!

Earn unique achievements as you master your magical abilities and collect powerful relics that will aid you in your quest. The coven’s power is at your fingertips—but will you have the courage to use it?
